pulse.subtitle: Direct-fire kinetic
pulse.description: Single-shot kinetic rifle. Long range, steady rate.
pulse.behavior: Fires a single round per shot. Path A: damage; T3 ignores resist-chip immunity. Path B: fire rate; +1 range at T3.
pulse.matchups: Strong against Triceratops. Workable against Parasaurs, Raptors, and T-Rex. Falls off against other heavies. T3 Annihilator's armor pierce strips resist-chip immunity.

chain.subtitle: Arc lightning
chain.description: Arcs lightning between targets. Damage falls off per jump.
chain.behavior: Hits the primary, then jumps to up to 4 nearby targets within 3.5 tiles. Damage falls 40% per jump (less with upgrades). Path A: more chains; T3 removes falloff. Path B: damage; T3 strips electric resist on hit.
chain.matchups: Dedicated swarm-killer. Strong against Swarm, Parasaur, Stegosaur, and Raptor. Minimal effect on Triceratops, Apatosaur, and Matriarch.

cryo.subtitle: Freezing aura
cryo.description: Continuous freezing aura. Negligible damage; the slow is the payload.
cryo.behavior: Aura ticks every ~0.67s. Slows enemies in range to 40% speed for 1.5s. No damage at base. Path A: deeper slow; T3 pauses regen on frozen targets. Path B: range; T3 unlocks a cold-damage AoE.
cryo.matchups: Cold is the only effective damage type against Apatosaur and Matriarch. Slow is reduced against Stegosaur, Triceratops, Apatosaur, and Matriarch.

mortar.subtitle: Splash artillery
mortar.description: Lobs explosive shells. Generous splash, slow reload.
mortar.behavior: Lobs an explosive shell at the target. 1.8-tile splash, 0.5 shots/sec. Spot mode pre-sights a chokepoint; shells drop when enemies enter the splash. Path B T3 (Singularity) deals 3× damage to shields.
mortar.matchups: Built for Swarms. Falls off against heavy targets. T3 Singularity is the primary shield-cracker.

flame.subtitle: Cone of fire
flame.description: Forward cone of fire. Short range, high tick rate.
flame.behavior: 60° forward cone at 5 ticks/sec. Low per-tick, constant; front ranks absorb most of the heat in giant crowds. Path A: damage; T3 (Napalm) suppresses regen on hit. Path B: fire rate and range.
flame.matchups: Strong against swarms at the front of the cone, minimal against heavies. Giant floods still want Mortar support. Primary regen counter: T3 Napalm + tick rate keeps regen suppressed.

hive.subtitle: Drone support
hive.description: Drones orbit assigned towers and boost their fire rate. Deals no damage.
hive.behavior: Spawns 3 drones; assign them to nearby towers for +30% fire rate each. Path A: up to 6 drones. No more than 3 can stack on one tower. Path B: buff up to +50%. Idle drones orbit the hive.
hive.matchups: Amplifies whatever it's assigned to. Strong pairings with Mortar (shield-cracking) and Cryo (faster aura ticks).
